evidence.reason: The catch at line 172 maps every non-AccountingGitError to exit code 3. A filesystem rejection such as EIO from readFile or atomicWrite is an execution failure, not an explicit needs-human refusal, so it is misreported as 3 instead of 1. The same generic classifier is used in the other route noted at 301-307. This is a routine exit-code correctness defect; no current-contract clause or accepted limitation retires it.
